label: Cal.com
description: Open-source scheduling platform for booking meetings and managing availability.
notes: The vendored cal-com piece defines zero actions (actions: [] in src/index.ts); it ships only three webhook triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED), which are out of scope for the HTTP node runtime (webhook registration + context.store). Nothing to transpile. Auth would map to CALCOM_API_KEY (SecretText passed as apiKey query param against https://api.cal.com/v1) if actions are added later.
